# pantechdynamics_container_registry_token (Resource)

A registry token: a credential for CI or a cluster to pull, or push, images, and nothing else (it cannot call the Pantech API). Log in with docker login <registry_host> -u pantech -p <secret>. Tokens cannot change, so changing any argument replaces the token, which issues a new secret and revokes the old one. **The secret is shown only when the token is created, so it is kept in Terraform state: treat the state as a secret.** Destroying the resource revokes the token. At most 50 per organization; only an API key made by an owner or admin can manage them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A push token for CI, limited to one repository. Its secret is shown only
# when the token is created, so it is kept in Terraform state: treat the state
# as a secret. Tokens cannot change: changing any argument issues a new token.
resource "pantechdynamics_container_registry_token" "ci" {
  name         = "github-actions"
  permission   = "push"
  repositories = ["api/server"]
  expires_at   = "2027-11-10T00:00:00Z"
}

# A pull token for a cluster, for every repository in the namespace.
resource "pantechdynamics_container_registry_token" "cluster" {
  name       = "prod-cluster-pull"
  permission = "pull"
}

# docker login <registry_host> -u pantech -p <secret>
output "ci_registry_password" {
  value     = pantechdynamics_container_registry_token.ci.secret
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) A name for the token, such as "github-actions". Changing it replaces the token.
- `permission` (String) "pull" (read images) or "push" (push and pull). Changing it replaces the token.

### Optional

- `expires_at` (String) When the token stops working, in RFC 3339, such as "2027-11-10T00:00:00Z". Leave it out for a token that does not expire. Changing it replaces the token.
- `repositories` (Set of String) The repositories (names in the namespace, such as "api/server") the token works for. Leave it out for every repository in the namespace. Changing it replaces the token.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the token was created, in RFC 3339 UTC, to the second.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the token, starting with prt_.
- `last_used_at` (String) When the token was last used, in RFC 3339 UTC, to the second. Null until first use.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) The token's secret (prt_..._...), the password for docker login. The API shows it only in the create response, so it exists only in Terraform state. It is null after an import.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A token is imported by its id. Its secret cannot be read back, so secret is
# null after an import; replace the token to have Terraform hold a secret.
terraform import pantechdynamics_container_registry_token.ci prt_06ggf6abcdefghjkmnpqrstvw
```
